objectives.text: Foster economic development and create or preserve job opportunities in both urban and rural areas by providing long-term financing for small business concerns through the development company program.

citations.quote: The Congress hereby finds and declares that the purpose of this subchapter is to foster economic development and to create or preserve job opportunities in both urban and rural areas by providing long-term financing for small business concerns through the development company program authorized by this subchapter.

obligations.action: make loans to State development companies to assist in carrying out the purposes of this chapter

citations.quote: The Administration is authorized to make loans to State development companies to assist in carrying out the purposes of this chapter.

obligations.actor: Development company (funds advanced under this subsection)
obligations.action: provide obligations in exchange for advanced funds which bear interest at such rate, and contain such other terms, as the Administration may fix
obligations.trigger: Any funds advanced under this subsection

citations.quote: Any funds advanced under this subsection shall be in exchange for obligations of the development company which bear interest at such rate, and contain such other terms, as the Administration may fix, and funds may be so advanced without regard to the use and investment by the development company of funds secured by it from other sources.

obligations.action: purchase and hold outstanding at any one time obligations from any one State development company exceeding the total amount borrowed by it from all other sources
obligations.threshold: shall not exceed the total amount borrowed by it from all other sources

citations.quote: The total amount of obligations purchased and outstanding at any one time by the Administration under this section from any one State development company shall not exceed the total amount borrowed by it from all other sources.

obligations.actor: Funds advanced to a State development company (treatment)
obligations.action: be treated on an equal basis with those funds borrowed by such company after August 21, 1958, regardless of source, which have the highest priority
exceptions: except when this requirement is waived by the Administrator

citations.quote: Funds advanced to a State development company under this section shall be treated on an equal basis with those funds borrowed by such company after August 21, 1958, regardless of source, which have the highest priority, except when this requirement is waived by the Administrator.

obligations.action: demonstrate that the project to be funded is directed toward at least one of the listed economic development objectives
obligations.trigger: In order to qualify for assistance under this subchapter
obligations.threshold: at least one of the following economic development objectives
exceptions: If eligibility is based upon the criteria set forth in paragraph (2) or (3), the project need not meet the job creation or job preservation criteria developed by the Administration if the overall portfolio of the development company meets or exceeds such job creation or retention criteria.

citations.quote: In order to qualify for assistance under this subchapter, the development company must demonstrate that the project to be funded is directed toward at least one of the following economic development objectives-

If eligibility is based upon the criteria set forth in paragraph (2) or (3), the project need not meet the job creation or job preservation criteria developed by the Administration if the overall portfolio of the development company meets or exceeds such job creation or retention criteria.

obligations.action: meets the objective set forth in subsection (d)(1) if the project creates or retains one job for every $65,000 guaranteed by the Administration
obligations.trigger: if the project creates or retains one job for every $65,000 guaranteed by the Administration
obligations.threshold: one job for every $65,000 guaranteed; except $100,000 in the case of a project of a small manufacturer
exceptions: except that the amount is $100,000 in the case of a project of a small manufacturer

citations.quote: A project meets the objective set forth in subsection (d)(1) if the project creates or retains one job for every $65,000 guaranteed by the Administration, except that the amount is $100,000 in the case of a project of a small manufacturer.

obligations.action: Paragraph (1) does not apply to a project for which eligibility is based on the objectives set forth in paragraph (2) or (3) of subsection (d), if the portfolio of outstanding debentures creates or retains one job for every $65,000 guaranteed
obligations.trigger: if the development company's portfolio of outstanding debentures creates or retains one job for every $65,000 guaranteed by the Administration

citations.quote: Paragraph (1) does not apply to a project for which eligibility is based on the objectives set forth in paragraph (2) or (3) of subsection (d), if the development company's portfolio of outstanding debentures creates or retains one job for every $65,000 guaranteed by the Administration.

obligations.action: average not more than $75,000 per job created or retained for projects in Alaska, Hawaii, State-designated enterprise zones, empowerment zones and enterprise communities, labor surplus areas, and other areas designated by the Administrator
obligations.trigger: For projects in Alaska, Hawaii, State-designated enterprise zones, empowerment zones and enterprise communities, labor surplus areas, as determined by the Secretary of Labor, and for other areas designated by the Administrator
obligations.threshold: not more than $75,000 per job created or retained

citations.quote: For projects in Alaska, Hawaii, State-designated enterprise zones, empowerment zones and enterprise communities, labor surplus areas, as determined by the Secretary of Labor, and for other areas designated by the Administrator, the development company's portfolio may average not more than $75,000 per job created or retained.

obligations.actor: Loans for projects of small manufacturers
obligations.action: be excluded from calculations under paragraph (2) or (3)

citations.quote: Loans for projects of small manufacturers shall be excluded from calculations under paragraph (2) or (3).

obligations.action: waive, on a case-by-case basis or by regulation, any requirement of this subsection (other than paragraph (4))
obligations.trigger: Under regulations prescribed by the Administrator

citations.quote: Under regulations prescribed by the Administrator, the Administrator may waive, on a case-by-case basis or by regulation, any requirement of this subsection (other than paragraph (4)).

obligations.action: adopt a dollar amount that is lower than the amounts set forth in paragraphs (1), (2), and (3) with respect to any waiver
obligations.threshold: lower than the amounts set forth in paragraphs (1), (2), and (3)

citations.quote: With respect to any waiver the Administrator is prohibited from adopting a dollar amount that is lower than the amounts set forth in paragraphs (1), (2), and (3).

definitions.definition: a small business concern (A) the primary business of which is classified in sector 31, 32, or 33 of the North American Industrial Classification System; and (B) all of the production facilities of which are located in the United States.

citations.quote: As used in this subsection, the term "small manufacturer" means a small business concern-
(A) the primary business of which is classified in sector 31, 32, or 33 of the North American Industrial Classification System; and
(B) all of the production facilities of which are located in the United States.

notes: Snapshot/currency note: header states 'Text contains those laws in effect on July 22, 2026.' The 2009 amendment note flags an internal drafting inconsistency preserved as written: Pub. L. 111-5 'directed amendment of section 501(e)(1), (2)' but was 'executed... to reflect the probable intent of Congress.' The prior-version 'rural areas' definition (populations less than 20,000) was amended out in 1990 and appears only in the Amendments editorial note; it is recorded here as (undefined here) in the current text. The Loan Liquidation Pilot Program provisions (Pub. L. 104-208 §204) are set-out statutory notes with several 'shall' duties on the Administrator and development companies; these are pilot/historical and scheduled to cease upon issuance of final regulations under §697g, so they were captured as an interaction rather than as live core obligations, consistent with the fidelity rule against resolving currency status.
